blocks.content:
Established: 1988
Statutory: 1992
Act: SEBI Act, 1992
HQ: Mumbai
Protects Investors
Quasi-Judicial Authority

items: Distinguish between establishment year (1988) and statutory status year (1992) as this is a frequent question.
SEBI headquarters location (Mumbai) is frequently asked in general awareness sections.
Remember that SEBI possesses Quasi-Judicial Authority to protect investor interests.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: SEBI was established in 1988 and attained statutory powers in 1992.
It is governed by the SEBI Act, 1992.
The headquarters of SEBI is situated in Mumbai.
Primary duties include protecting investors and exercising Quasi-Judicial Authority.
